news.title: Victim was 6 when abuse began; man convicted on all 18 counts in child abuse case
news.summary: A Cherokee County jury convicted a 64-year-old man of all 18 charges he faced involving sex crimes against a child, according to the Blue Ridge Judicial Circuit District Attorney’s Office.

news.title: Victim of deadly Atlanta accident was 45-year-old woman, police say
news.summary: The Atlanta Police Department says they are investigating a deadly accident along Winsor St SW and Interstate 20 eastbound.

news.title: Tennessee homicide suspect arrested after Cobb County I-75 chase, GSP says
news.summary: A 21-year-old Tennessee man wanted in a homicide investigation was arrested Wednesday following a high-speed pursuit on Interstate 75 in Cobb County, according to authorities.

news.title: Man arrested in connection with July triple shooting, Atlanta police say
news.summary: A 27-year-old man was arrested on Wednesday in connection with a July triple shooting in Atlanta, according to police.

news.title: Man hospitalized after Midtown road-rage shooting, Atlanta police say
news.summary: A 20-year-old man is recovering in the hospital after being shot during an early Saturday morning road-rage incident in Midtown, according to Atlanta police.

news.title: Man injured after late-night shooting in southwest Atlanta, police say
news.summary: A 31-year-old man is recovering in the hospital after being shot late Friday night in southwest Atlanta, according to police.
